name: io.github.tonyyang0504/awin-mcp
description: Awin (ads): me, list_accounts, get_report. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_AWIN_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Personal Awin API token (https://ui.awin.com/awin-api > 'Show my API token'), sent as `Authorization: Bearer`. It is user-level: it reaches every advertiser account the user has at least viewer access to. Advertiser API access requires an Accelerate or Advanced plan.
